Telangana coal block allocation sparks inter-state dispute

A dispute has arisen over the allocation of the Tadicherla-2 coal block in Telangana's Godavari basin. Telangana's government claims sustained efforts led to the allocation, while a state minister has requested the Centre allocate all coal blocks in the basin to the Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL). This disagreement highlights differing perspectives on resource management and inter-governmental coordination.
